reports.title: Sunny Day on the Bow
reports.comment:
quick: Took a tour up to the Bow Glacier,
Heard lots of whumpfing as we were getting on the glacier. Higher up on it the wind effect was very noticeable, snow varied from 15cm to 50cm depending on the pocket on the glacier.
Lower down made for some great turns with snow depth ranging from calf to knee deep. / weather: Winds on and off through the day, strong winds kicked in just after lunch up on …
